description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes a regulatory requirement for special allowance payments to workers in specific trades based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under the authority of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a statutory instrument that sets compliance requirements for employers, falling under Legal/Regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
